bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs, springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (manifest-declared share targets); springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (app-declared actions); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (app sandbox)
summary: ExtensionKit lets a third-party app extension supply a custom UI that the host app presents out of process, and lets the user enable or disable extensions. BifrOSt has no app-extension model: apps cannot supply UI that another app hosts, and there is no extension management UI. The nearest pieces are a manifest-based share target list and App Intents, neither of which is an extension point.

features.feature: Extension-based UI in a host app (remote views)
features.apple: ExtensionKit: Including extension-based UI in your interface (article)
features.note: No out-of-process view hosting between apps. Views are built and drawn inside the app that owns them.
No scene type an extension can publish for a host to render.

features.feature: Host view controller for remote extension views
features.bifrost: none; springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs:40 ControllerHost<C> hosts a view controller in the same process only
features.note: ControllerHost does not isolate or load another app's view.

features.apple: EXAppExtensionBrowserViewController; Displaying the app extensions available to your app (article)
features.note: No user-facing list to approve, enable or disable extensions for an app.

features.feature: Share targets provided by other apps
features.apple: Share extensions (ExtensionKit host of ExtensionFoundation share UI)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (show_picker); springboard/src/shell/sharing.rs (targets from manifest handles and schemes)
features.note: Other apps can receive shared items when they declare handles or schemes in their manifest. Apps cannot ship their own share UI or a share view that the picker hosts. docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Share sheet' lists share-sheet extensions as a gap.

features.feature: Actions declared by apps for other surfaces
features.apple: App Intents (separate from ExtensionKit; listed for context)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (App::intents, perform_intent over the control socket)
features.note: Apps declare typed actions and entities, but the shell does not host any extension UI for them.

features.feature: Process isolation for third-party app code
features.apple: Extension processes launched and sandboxed by the system (ExtensionFoundation runtime)
features.note: The OS sandboxes apps, but no SDK API lets an app load another app's extension process.

gaps: No app-extension model: apps cannot publish a UI or service that another app hosts (AppExtensionScene, EXHostViewController).
No extension enable and disable management UI (EXAppExtensionBrowserViewController) for the user to approve or turn off extensions per app.
No out-of-process remote view hosting; ControllerHost in springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs runs in the owner's process only.
Share sheet targets are limited to apps with manifest handles or schemes; app-supplied share extensions are missing (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Share sheet).
